info.cls_ename: MONASH-FCU 2+2 Bachelor's Program in Information Technology

description.describe_ch: A fun course for building Python programs and analyzing data applications and program design. Students will have gained a fundamental understanding of programming in Python by creating a variety of programs and applications for the Web and for systems development. Python is a versatile programming language, suitable for projects ranging from small programs to large systems. The program emphasizes best practices where students will explore the large standard library of Python, which supports many common programming tasks in everyday applications.
description.describe_eh: A fun course for building Python programs and analyzing data applications and program design. Students will have gained a fundamental understanding of programming in Python by creating a variety of programs and applications for the Web and for systems development. Python is a versatile programming language, suitable for projects ranging from small programs to large systems. The program emphasizes best practices where students will explore the large standard library of Python, which supports many common programming tasks in everyday applications.

targets.describe_ch:
1. 了解甚麼是AI人工智慧，並能區分AI、機器學習(ML)與深度學習的異同
（能力編號B；能力層次2）
2. 了解ML處理問題的流程步驟，並練習如何將生活/專業領域遭遇的問題，以ML流程架構解決

gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno:
考試作弊經查獲，當次考試零分計算，並送獎逞委員會審議，處罰建議一大過。
課堂活動、問卷、與作業都列入評分考量，請同學務必參與，若無法參與相關分數以零分計算。
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en:
Cheating in exams will result in a score of zero for that exam and will be reported to the Student Rewards and Disciplinary Committee for review. The recommended penalty is one major demerit.
Class activities, surveys, and assignments are all included in the grading criteria. Students are required to participate; failure to do so will result in a score of zero for the respective components.
